Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
RETRACTOR, HAJEK'S PATTERN 



( Reaffirmed 2006 ) 



1- Scope— Dimensional and other requirements for Hajel^'s pattern retractor used in ENT surgery. 
2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 



o 

a 

Q. 

u 
S 

E 

£ 
o 
U 

T5 

c 
o 




All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 RETRACTOR, HAJEK'S PATTERN 

2.1 A deviation of ± 2'5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions- 

3. Material — Stainless steel sheet conforming to Designation 04Cr18Ni10 or 07Cr18Ni9 of IS : 6911- 
1972 ' Specification for stainless steel plate, sheet and strip \ 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The retractor shall be of one piece construction and shall be free from burrs, pits, cracks and 
other surface flaws, 

4.2 The edges of the retractor shall be even, rounded and shall not be sharp. 

4.3 The retractor shall be polished bright and passivated. 

4.4 The thickness of the retractor shall be uniform throughout. 



Adopted 18 January 1977 



February 1977. ISI

18:8316-1977 

5. Test 

5.1 Corrosion Resistance — Test the retractor in accordance with 15:7531-1975 'Method for boiling 
and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instruments '. The retractor 
shall not show any sign of corrosion at the end of the test, 

6. Marking — The retractor shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name,- 
Initials or registered trade-mark, and the country of manufacture, 

6.1 ISI Certification Marliing— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Packing — The retractor shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or packed in polyethylene 
bags. I he retractor may also be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
